content.short: KuberIDE is a browser-based development environment for writing, testing, and deploying Plutus smart contracts.
content.description: KuberIDE is a comprehensive browser-based Integrated Development Environment (IDE) specifically designed to streamline the smart contract lifecycle on Cardano. It eliminates complex local setup requirements, allowing developers to write, compile, and deploy Plutus scripts directly from their browser. The platform includes powerful tools like a Transaction Builder (TxBuilder) for address composition and hex encoding/decoding. By providing an audit-ready environment, KuberIDE simplifies the onboarding process for new developers and enhances productivity for the entire ecosystem.
